|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[A Disturbance In The Force (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. If you just verified opponent's Reserve Deck, you may either: place one card found there with the word "Podracer(s)" in game text out of play OR retrieve 1 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. Whenever you verify opponent’s Reserve Deck, may place a card there with “podracer” in game text out of play or retrieve 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' “If” → “Whenever”; “just verified opponent's” → “verify opponent’s”; removed “you”; removed “either:”; “one” → “a”; removed “found”; “the word "Podracer(s)"” → ““podracer””; “OR” → “or”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 26. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[A Disturbance In The Force]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[A Disturbance In The Force (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[A Disturbance In The Force]]. Code OVS3 · GEMP id 1103_26.
